title: Cast Iron 5 Hole Egg Frying Pan Fast Heating Thick Bottom Heavy Duty Breakfast Pan For Gas Stove Induction Cooker
body_html: 1、5 Hole Egg Pan: Simplify your morning routine with this cast iron five hole egg pan. Cook multiple eggs at once, saving time and effort. Perfect for making omelets, pancakes, or fried eggs. 2、Durable Cast Iron Construction: Made from cast iron, this egg pan ensures even heat distribution for consistent cooking results. Its sturdy construction enables long lasting use without warping or scratching. 3、Non Stick: The non stick egg pan allows for easy food release and effortless cleaning. Say goodbye to stubborn residue and spend more time enjoying your delicious breakfast. 4、Thick Bottom for Better Heat Retention: The thick bottom of this pan provides enhanced heat retention, ensuring your eggs are cooked evenly. Say goodbye to unevenly cooked eggs. 5、Solid Wood Handle for Safe and Comfortable Grip: The solid wood handle stays cool during cooking and provides a comfortable grip while flipping or transferring your eggs.Item Type: Egg PanMaterial: Cast Iron + Solid WoodWeight: Approx. 1407.00g / 49.63oz1 x Egg Pan1 x Handle
